thread:
emily.release: Heads-up: short-notice tweak to this week's release freeze and updated canary rollback triggers. Please read and ack.

chris: what's changed?

emily.release: TL;DR: freeze moves earlier by 2 hours start and extends by 2 hours at the end for this cycle only (reason: scheduled infra firmware updates). Also publishing clear numeric rollback thresholds so teams know exactly when to stop a rollout.

zara: concrete times?

emily.release: New window: Tue 20:00 UTC -> Sat 10:00 UTC (was Wed 00:00 -> Sat 06:00). We're doing this to avoid clashing with the node firmware work on Wed 04:00 UTC.

release-bot: Calendar updated: https://go/release-calendar/211222 (auto-notify) :mega:

noah: what are the rollback rules? need the exact metrics to hook into alerts.

emily.release: Short summary of rollback triggers:
- Canary slice: error-rate >= 2.5% sustained over 10 minutes -> immediate rollback.
- CPU: host CPU > 85% for 5+ minutes during canary -> rollback.
- Latency: prod ramp P95 > 1.3x baseline for 15 minutes -> abort/roll back.
- Quality: if automated eval shows >1.5% failures on critical prompt set -> stop rollout.

ops-oncall: Grafana panels created: rollouts/canary/errors, rollouts/canary/cpu, rollouts/ramp/p95. Alerts will post to #rollout-alerts and trigger the rollback playbook.

chris: will rollback collect any debug artifacts?

emily.release: Yes. Each rollback will snapshot last-5m KV-cache stats + a light traceback bundle and upload to S3 at s3://redwood-rollbacks/<release-id>/snapshot.tar.gz for investigations.

zara: exceptions? if we need an emergency merge during freeze who signs off?

emily.release: For this cycle: eng-manager + oncall approval required. Use /policy-exception <release-id> and include reason + risk assessment.

ops-oncall: Quick playbook command we added:
```
# rollback to previous tag
redwood deploy rollback --service inference --to-tag v<prev> --note "auto-rollback: <alert>"
```

noah: will inform my team to stop merging earlier.

emily.release: Action items:
- All teams: do not merge to main from Tue 20:00 UTC -> Sat 10:00 UTC unless exception granted.
- Release leads: add preferred canary start offset to the spreadsheet by EOD.
- Ops: verify alert routing and S3 upload permissions.

chris: are we planning any hotpatches in the extended window?

emily.release: Expect 1 hotpatch slot Sat 02:0010:00 UTC. Hotpatches need eng-mgr + infra lead sign-off and must run a 5% canary smoke before wider rollout.

zara: thanks, publishing a short note to CS so they're not scheduling customer demos.

emily.release: Thanks everyone. This is a temporary adjustment for the infra work. We'll review post-cycle and incorporate changes into the release playbook if they help. Ping me or @ops-oncall with issues. :eyes:

release-bot: Reminder: automatic canary watch is 120 minutes after canary start.
